basic_details.short_information: Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya (UBKV) will hold a walk-in interview on 10 December 2026 at 12.00 Noon at the Conference Room Adjacent to the Directorate of Research, RKVY Building, Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya, Pundibari, Coochbehar. The interview is for 4 Project Assistant posts on a purely contractual (temporary) basis under Advertisement No. UBKV/DR-566 dated 26 November 2026. The selected candidates will get a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 25000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: About UBKV Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya is located at P.O. Pundibari, Dist. Coochbehar, West Bengal, PIN-736165. The Project Assistant posts are under the project entitled "National Soil Mapping Programme (NSMP), 1:10k scale for Soil Resource Mapping", funded by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, and located at Pundibari in the district of Coochbehar under the aegis of the university. The selected persons will work under the guidance of Prof. Dibyendu Mukhopadhyay, Principal Investigator, Dept. of Soil Science & Agriculture Chemistry, Faculty of Agriculture, UBKV, Pundibari, Cooch Behar. The notice is issued by the Director of Research (Actg.), Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There are 4 Project Assistant posts, and the notice splits them by the essential qualification. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Working experience of MS-Office / Remote sensing and GIS application / Field experience / Data Interpretation with statistical software / Laboratory Analysis / Report writing with good command in English. Experience in working with any externally funded project. Preference will be given to higher qualification/experience. Mere possession of the minimum qualification shall not make a candidate selected to the posts. Age should be below 35 years as on 01 November 2026. The remuneration is Rs. 25000/- per month (Consolidated). The tenure is up to 30 September 2027 or the date of completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The positions are purely temporary on a contractual basis and co-terminus with the project. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each position.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice does not ask for any application to be sent in advance. Candidates bring the following at the time of appearing at the interview: Two copies of application along with detailed bio-data. Two sets of photocopies of all documents, mark sheets and certificates starting from Madhyamik examination, duly attested by a Gazetted Officer / Head of the Institution. Two recent passport size photographs. Original mark sheets and certificates starting from Madhyamik examination, and other experience certificate, if any. Proof of Date of Birth, e.g. CBSE/ HSC/ SSC/ Matriculation certificate. SC/ST/OBC certificate, if applicable.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Applicants have to appear in person before a selection committee for the walk-in interview. Preference will be given to candidates whose research interest and work experience has relevance to the mandate of the project. The selection committee's decision will be final and binding in all respects. The Viswavidyalaya reserves the right to select anybody as recommended by the selection committee. The selected candidate will be offered the consolidated remuneration of Rs. 25000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be admissible to any candidate for attending the interview. Candidates should not have any type of conviction in the court anywhere in India. There is no provision of re-employment after termination of the project.

faq.question: Q1. When is the UBKV Project Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 December 2026 at 12.00 Noon.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the UBKV Project Assistant walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The venue is the Conference Room Adjacent to the Directorate of Research, RKVY Building, Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya, Pundibari, Coochbehar.

faq.question: Q3. How many Project Assistant vacancies are there at UBKV?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 3 for candidates with a Master's degree in Soil Science and Agriculture Chemistry/Agronomy and 1 for a Master's of Arts / Master's of Science in Geography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for UBKV Project Assistant?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Soil Science and Agriculture Chemistry/Agronomy from a recognized university/ Institute (3 positions), or a Master's of Arts / Master's of Science in Geography (1 position).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UBKV Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Age should be below 35 years as on 01 November 2026, with relaxation up to 5 years for SC/ST; further relaxation may be given to candidates with experience in such type of project/ programme.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of UBKV Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 25000/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the UBKV walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Two copies of application with detailed bio-data, two sets of attested photocopies of documents from Madhyamik onwards, two passport size photographs, original mark sheets and certificates, proof of Date of Birth, and SC/ST/OBC certificate if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. How will UBKV select Project Assistants?
faq.answer: Candidates appear in person before a selection committee for the walk-in interview, with preference to higher qualification/experience and to research interest and work experience relevant to the project.

faq.question: Q9. Is the UBKV Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary on a contractual basis, co-terminus with the project, with tenure up to 30 September 2027 or the date of completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the UBKV interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible to any candidate for attending the interview.
